title: "U-2 at Bodo, Norway" – U-2 parked at airfield with hills (Chapter 3, p. 143)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 aircraft parked on an airfield apron, with dark hills behind it and a ship mast visible at upper right. Captioned "U-2 at Bodo, Norway." It accompanies the section "Declining Overflight Activity," which notes that Operation SOFT TOUCH (4-27 August 1957) was the high-water mark of U-2 operations against the Soviet Union.
